propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns empty list both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure undetectable and causing derive_caused_by to tally over a subset when some paths fail
Partial per-path blame failures in derive_caused_by can elect a wrong caused_by culprit that would not have won over the full set, persisting incorrect links
git clone guidance must document --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) versus full clone (1.04 GiB / 59 s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 (3.57 GiB) must never be used
derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any per-path blame fails, after _blame_file_commits distinguishes None (failure) from [] (success with zero lines)
A path with legitimately zero blame lines must not trigger abort, preserving correct derivations for empty files
